save_rgb_results: save RGB ground truth and predicted reconstruction images to disk during EQA-CNN-Pretrain evaluation
save_seg_results: save ground truth and predicted segmentation maps as colored images using d3 40 color palette
save_depth_results: save ground truth and predicted depth maps as images during EQA-CNN-Pretrain evaluation
put_vqa_text_on_image: overlay VQA question, prediction, and ground truth answer text onto an image using OpenCV
save_vqa_image_results: save VQA input images with overlaid question, prediction, and ground truth text as a collage
